restriction_review.scope: Eight explicit maintained-primary recharge/conversion formulas, only original Tinkering57/Gnome12 branch, with exact explicit item IDs and physical reagents. NoSkill recharging-kit alternatives remain unqualified.
restriction_review.charges: Successcount1 means one physical original device, not charge count. Six self-recharges preserve owned item definition; two Full/Half routes replace only its base definition. Restore full source charges5/60/10/10/5/20/5/5 as applicable. No fresh factory output. Old eight manufacturing/other recharge peers remain unchanged, including legacy Full outputcount10.
restriction_review.source: Seven explicit No Fail Combine markers encode LOCAL trivial0/nofail1; Chipped Bone Rod Augmenter explicitly15 No-Fail. Source literal text and uncertainties retained. Potion activation-note materials are not recharge inputs. Era floor19 is selected maintained-legacy scope policy, not immutable May2013 introduction proof.
restriction_review.availability: LOCAL manual-only owned root Toolbox17902/type10/8slots/size4. Same original kit slot, device child slot and GUID. Accept original device charges0..native cap including already full. Exact whole physical manual reagent units; reject excess stacks, extra children, unsupported scaling/evolving roots and unsupported reagent augments/evolution. No player race inferred from wearable definitions.
restriction_review.custody: One finite native strict transaction locks original actor/session lease, full owned parent/children/GUIDs, exact roles/definitions and evolving augment custody. Atomically update device itemID/charges and delete exact reagent rows. Raw custom bytes, attunement, color, ornaments, GUID, augment evolving identity, timers and task-delivery counts retained. Preallocate clones/proof/packet/retirement capacity before known COMMIT, then publish memory before callbacks. Unknown COMMIT attaches existing generic inventory admission hold with no retry/refund/inverse.
restriction_review.learning: Preserve ordinary native tradeskill success/skill-credit/events and manual learning/madecount. No neverlearn claim. Automatic requests denied before mutable validators, and selectors changed into recharges denied again before debit. Only finite one-use private proof suppresses factory output for these eight IDs.
restriction_review.preservation: Fifteen full18 native item dependencies and eight full unchanged existing producer headers/74entries guarded; all-state exact-input collision guard has no exemptions. Finite name exceptions cover captured old peers and staged sibling IDs only. Old recipes, items, learned state and existing native writer behavior unchanged. No item definitions added.
restriction_review.execution: Source proposal only. GitHub alone publishes after actual branch/head and exact native preimage checks. Build alone compiles/installs compatible actor. Database owner applies exact SQL after coordinator GO and installed actor receipt. No Tradeskills SQL/build/runtime actions or native gameplay acceptance. Keep RRC310 SQL held until compatible actor install.
